judge.rationale: The candidate delivers all functional requirements from the issue, including Ajv-based input validation, static registration-time schema compilation, WeakMap caching for dynamic schemas, safe error reporting without value leakage, and comprehensive unit/acceptance tests linked to the specification. In fact, the candidate implements the orchestrator retry test (round 1 invalid -> round 2 corrected tool call -> round 3 completion) and static compilation reuse test even more thoroughly than the reference PR. However, the candidate also includes unrequested artifacts and repository churn: it leaves `.lore/dod.md` and a separate `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file in the tree, cuts a `0.4.0` release in `package.json` and `CHANGELOG.md` (deleting the `## [Unreleased]` heading instead of adding an unreleased entry), and touches unrelated specs (`ADR-002`, `hal-engine-tool-responses`, `hal-engine-architecture`, `hal-engine-config-hooks`) due to line-number shifts from inserting its orchestrator test at the top of the `describe` block instead of the bottom.
